reviewType: supplemental independent rendered-image review in the actual full-course page context
reviewer: visual_b; independent of fragment C model author

supplements.relationship: The earlier focused visual/semantic review remains separate. This report adds direct inspection of every actual-page rendering; no approval is transferred on an assumed visual equivalence.

reviewedTree.binding: Exact authored model and renderer hashes below. The actual-page capture started before the final caption-only change in exercise 408; its four affected renderings were replaced by the fresh actual-page targeted captures. The remaining 384 images are from the complete course run.

captureSets.source: Fresh actual index-page targeted exercise-408 browser capture after the A₁B₁ caption correction

renderedImageReview.method: All 388 full model-region screenshots from the actual course index page were opened through the image viewer in 34 contact sheets, including geometry, tools, currently unlocked case controls and captions. No region was cropped from the source screenshots. Desktop images were proportionally reduced in the sheets; mobile images retained their original width. The replacement exercise-408 desktop captions were also opened at original size. Every final screenshot hash was rechecked after viewing.
criteria: labels readable and attributable to geometry
correct neutral, step and alternative scenes
case controls fit the actual page layout and reflect unlock state
corrected A₁B₁ caption visible in both affected exercise-408 views at both widths

limitations: This report reviews model-region screenshots within the actual page context. It does not claim independent execution of the full interaction gate, a complete surrounding-page accessibility review, physical-device testing or learner testing.
The complete-course gate outcome is recorded separately by the integrator.
